model.architecture: Dense decoder (spark2_5 remote code, 28L, hidden 2048, 8 query / 2 KV heads of 256, sliding-window(512) x3 : full x1, per-head sigmoid attention-output gate, exact-GELU gated MLP, 131,072-entry tied vocab); reasoning model that works problems inside <think>...</think>, thought channel declared in bundle metadata and the think opener pre-filled by the bundle's Jinja generation prompt

session_defaults.notes: Reasoning model: give it a generous output budget (>=2048; 3584 for math) - truncated mid-thought it produces no final answer. The declared thought channel routes reasoning out of the streamed answer and makes a thinking budget effective; enable_thinking=false renders the vendor's no-think prompt. Vendor sampling recommendation temperature 1.0 / top_p 0.95; all card numbers are greedy.

variants.quantization: export-time int4 blockwise-32 + OCTAV on linears, int8 embedding in its own section (EXTERNALIZE_EMBEDDER: the vocab is tied and a split int4/int8 request duplicates the table per signature) - GSM8K (same harness) 66 vs bf16 76 (paired: both 61, bf16-only 15 of which 9 are 3584-token cap hits, int4-only 5); 8Q 8/8 cpu + 8/8 gpu

recommended.reason: measured on one Galaxy S26 (2026-09-07, 2 runs per cell): GPU 307-459 tok/s prefill / 17.4-17.8 decode against CPU 83-186 / 13.6-13.9; peak 1325 MB (GPU) vs 1961 MB (CPU); full OpenCL delegation (1733/1733 nodes). Same-device CPU control taken - a measured win; the fastest-decoding Spark file on this device

variants.quantization: export-time dynamic int8 on linears + embedding (dynamic_wi8_afp32) - GSM8K (n=100, greedy, 0-shot CoT, 3584 output tokens, own harness) 76 vs bf16 76 (paired: both 71, bf16-only 5, int8-only 5); 8Q 8/8 cpu + 8/8 gpu (bf16 8/8)

recommended.reason: measured on one Galaxy S26 with one binary (2026-09-07, 205-token prompt, 2 runs per cell): GPU 303-637 tok/s prefill / 13.9-15.8 decode against CPU 165-301 / 12.0-12.3; peak 1098 MB (GPU) vs 2606 MB (CPU). Same-device CPU control taken - a measured win. Full OpenCL delegation (1736/1736 nodes on every subgraph); the int4 sibling decodes 12% faster on this GPU (17.4-17.8) at a 31% smaller download

platform_notes: Tested on litert-lm 0.17.0 (macOS CLI + python API) and the iPhone 17 Pro (G41DeviceTest harness, Metal GPU and CPU)

Jinja prompt template carried verbatim (vendor format: default system block, every message wrapped <｜start▁of▁sentence｜>...<｜end▁of▁sentence｜>, generation prompt <|Bot|><think>); tool-call formatting not carried; stop id 1; KV budget 4096, 11 prefill signatures (1-1024)
No start_token: add_bos_token is false and the template carries its own BOS per message

Single 1.706 GiB TFLite section - loads on iOS (under the ~2 GiB single-section mmap ceiling); iPhone 17 Pro composite 8Q 7/8 on both backends (the one miss is the composite-format rhyme artifact; the same question is answered correctly standalone)
Embeds the upstream HF tokenizer.json (byte-level BPE); engine-vs-tokenizers ids identical on 234/234 probe rows
